## Cleaning steps

<!-- eda:start -->
### Cleaning steps applied (auto-generated by the eda command)
- Split `description` on newline and dropped blank lines.
- Unicode NFKC normalisation and lowercasing.
- Deleted apostrophes ("bird's" -> "birds"); turned every other non-alphanumeric character
  (punctuation, hyphens, quotes) into a space; collapsed whitespace.
- Typo correction: a word seen at most 2 times in the train captions, at least 6 letters long, is
  replaced by the most frequent word (seen at least 20 times) that is one edit away (deletion,
  adjacent swap, substitution or insertion). The map is built from train captions only and applied
  to train and test. Duplicate and unusually short/long captions are kept and counted, not removed.
- Images are converted to 3-channel RGB in the transforms (grayscale/RGBA files).

## Failed experiments

- **Colab runs lost (2026-10-30).** Tried: training and tuning on free Colab T4 with results written to the runtime's local disk and copied to Drive only in the last notebook cell. Result: the daily GPU limit cut sessions, the runtime reset, `outputs/checkpoints` was gone and the evaluate step failed with missing checkpoints. Cause: nothing persisted before the end. Fix: `outputs/{checkpoints,history,eval,tuning,figures,eda}` are symlinks to Drive, the trainer saves `<run>.last.pt` after every epoch, and `--resume` skips finished runs and continues an interrupted one (data order after a resume is not bit-identical).

- **Results written to Colab local disk again (2026-10-31).** Tried: the final runs with `outputs/*` as plain folders because the notebook's symlink cell had not taken effect (`ls -l outputs` showed no symlinks; `final/` on Drive was empty). Result: after the refresh the checkpoints and history JSONs were gone. Cause: symlink cell skipped/failed after a runtime reset, so nothing went to Drive. Fix: `fetch-checkpoints` restored all 9 checkpoints from W&B artifacts; the symlinks were rebuilt and verified with `ls -l outputs` before continuing; every model was re-evaluated on the test set. Per-epoch history of the 7 other main runs was not restored, so their curves come from W&B.
- **`resnet18_tuned` was not tuned (2026-10-31).** Tried: retraining the best tuned setting. Result: its test metrics were identical to `resnet18_finetune` to four decimals. Cause: `configs/resnet18_tuned.yaml` still held the defaults (lr 1e-4, dropout 0.5), so the same seed gave the same model; the grid winner had never been copied in. Fix: set lr_backbone 3e-4, lr_head 3e-3, weight decay 1e-4, dropout 0.2 and retrained.
- **Tuning did not help at the full budget (2026-10-31).** The grid winner (chosen after 5 epochs per trial, 6 trials) scored 74.34% test accuracy at 30 epochs versus 75.08% for the untuned fine-tune (difference of about 43 test images, within run-to-run noise). Suspected reason: a higher learning rate wins a 5-epoch race but gains nothing over 30 epochs with cosine decay; the budget (6 trials, 5 epochs) was also too small to separate Grid (0.707) from Random (0.696) in best score or time (1578 s vs 1605 s).

- **Caption cleaning was too shallow, then too aggressive (2026-11-02).** Tried: (1) lowercase + whitespace only, with punctuation and typos deferred to Milestone 2. Result: 6,690 "words", half of them seen once, mostly punctuation glued to words; 27 train / 29 test captions had every space replaced by U+FFFD (encoding damage) and looked like one-word captions. Fix: strip punctuation and normalise Unicode (vocabulary 6,690 -> 4,061). (2) A one-edit typo map with words of 5+ letters. Result: it also changed valid words (`alone` -> `along`, `bread` -> `broad`, `lover` -> `over`). Fix: only words of 6+ letters (530 -> 323 corrections). Some valid words are still changed (`curling` -> `curving`, `clunky` -> `chunky`), roughly 20-25% of the first 20 corrections; accepted and reported.
- **Final model was first picked on test accuracy (2026-11-02).** The report said the test set was never used for decisions but chose ResNet-50 by test score. Fix: the per-epoch histories are rebuilt from W&B (`fetch-history`) and `figures` writes `selection.csv`, ranking runs by best validation accuracy.

## Final test results (CUB test, 5794 images)

| Run | Accuracy | F1 macro |
|---|---|---|
| scratch_cnn | 0.1731 | 0.1547 |
| resnet18_random | 0.3773 | 0.3665 |
| resnet18_frozen | 0.6075 | 0.6074 |
| resnet18_finetune | 0.7508 | 0.7505 |
| resnet18_tuned (grid best params) | 0.7434 | 0.7409 |
| resnet50_frozen | 0.6344 | 0.6311 |
| resnet50_finetune (best) | 0.8070 | 0.8060 |
| efficientnet_b0_frozen | 0.7694 | 0.7698 |
| efficientnet_b0_finetune | 0.7832 | 0.7838 |

Benchmark: ResNet-50 baseline in the NTS-Net paper is 84.5% (448x448 input, longer training); our 80.7% uses 224x224. Grad-CAM was run for `resnet50_finetune` and `scratch_cnn`.

## Milestone 1 status

Complete (2026-11-02). Checked against spec section 6.1 and section 9.

### What exists
- Task 1.1: class distribution, image sizes and quality, caption statistics, anomalies and plots (`eda`); `description` split and cleaned (punctuation removed, rare typos corrected, see "Cleaning steps"); stratified train/validation split from train; augmentation strategy with examples.
- Task 1.2: ScratchCNN baseline plus ResNet-18 from random weights; transfer learning with ResNet-18/50 and EfficientNet-B0 (frozen and fine-tuned); Grid and Random Search compared; W&B tracking of every run; Grad-CAM on correct and wrong predictions.
- Cross-cutting: modular `src/` and CLI (`eda, train, tune, evaluate, gradcam, predict, figures, fetch-checkpoints, fetch-history`), seeds, README and pinned requirements, metrics (accuracy, top-5, precision, recall, F1, confusion matrix), benchmark table against NTS-Net and TransFG, this failure log, and the report (`report/Team7_Milestone1_Report.pdf`).
- Training: 30 epochs maximum, patience 7, batch 64, seed 42, about 53 s per ResNet-18 epoch on a Colab T4. Final configs are in `configs/`.

### Known gaps
- The final model (`resnet50_finetune`) is chosen on validation accuracy (79.73%), not on test accuracy.
- The from-scratch models are still improving at epoch 30, so their scores are lower bounds.
- Each result is one run with seed 42; differences below about 1 point are within noise.
- The typo correction is a dictionary-free heuristic with roughly 75-80% precision on the first 20 corrections; a few valid words are changed.
- Validation loss includes label smoothing 0.1, so it never approaches 0; compare it across runs, not against 0.
- On CUDA the GradScaler may skip the first optimizer step (inf/NaN check), which produces a harmless scheduler warning.
- Run history, eval JSON, tuning and figures are git-ignored; the report uses copies of them.
- Unconfirmed whether "own CNN" in the spec allows a standard architecture; ScratchCNN is a small custom CNN trained from scratch, and ResNet-18 random init is an additional from-scratch baseline. Ask the TAs.
- `configs/benchmark.yaml` published numbers were re-checked against the NTS-Net and TransFG papers: 84.5 / 87.5 and 90.3 / 91.7.
- Colorization and captioning (Milestone 2) are not implemented; the CLI exits with a Milestone 2 message for them.
